item.title: The Two Generals Problem
item.description: The Two Generals Problem: neither general can ever confirm the other is ready to attack. Jim Gray proved it in 1978, and the same limit shapes how databases and networks handle failure.

item.title: Remote-First vs Remote-Friendly
item.description: So how do we do remote work right? It takes much more than the half-hearted “you’re allowed to work from home” policy you see at companies nowadays. Remote-first means working remote is the default. It means making sure your remote employees are as much a part of the team as those in the office.
